claude.algorithm: Maps messages/tools/results to Anthropic Messages, tool_use/tool_result/input_schema. Supports credential-dependent API-key/Bearer profiles and CLI compatibility fingerprints. Text deltas are forwarded; input_json_delta fragments are accumulated and the Chat Completions translator emits complete arguments at content_block_stop.
claude.reason: No independent authorized API credential was established for this subscription experiment. Do not replay the subscription OAuth token outside the official binary.

agy.algorithm: Uses private Cloud Code v1internal generation routes, OAuth credentials and provider-specific request identity/project handling. Maps messages to contents, tools to functionDeclarations, results to functionResponse. Maps functionCall.args from response parts into OpenAI tool_calls; this is not evidence of progressively streamed argument fragments.
agy.reason: Provider terms/FAQ restrict third-party access and warn of suspension. The FAQ also says headless wrapping is unsupported on consumer plans. Local official-binary measurements do not establish deployment permission.

opencode.algorithm: OpenCode is a provider router. An OpenAI-compatible executor can target an independently authorized provider endpoint, but is not a generic replay of an OpenCode login. The selected free Zen GLM route is tested through the official v2 server without enabling native tools or bypassing provider checks.
opencode.reason: No independently authorized API credential for the selected free model was established; no new key/login/model substitution is allowed in this study.

opencode.cleanupMechanism: startV2.close awaited child exit for the main private server and the diagnostic private server
